title: NeonLight
description: A simple mod that adds a singular block featuring 17 color variants, the Neon Sign! A glowing modular block suitable for large sign creation and displaying both letters and symbols in large glowing letters. Decorate your builds or server with custom signs!
body:
**Neon Light** currently adds one block, the **Neon Sign!** Crafted with _1 glowstone dust_ surrounded by _4 iron ingots_. **Neon Signs** can be recolored with _4 Neon Signs_ + _1 dye_. 

**Neon Signs** connect to adjacent signs of the same color, allowing for large displays.  Interact with an individual sign block and press a key to display it! Signs support all lower & upper case letters, numbers and various symbols. Signs will turn on once displaying a symbol and can be turned off via redstone connections. 

**Neon Signs** can be customized using the **Glowstone Wrench!** Crafted with _1 Iron Ingot_ + _1 Glowstone Dust_ + _Any Dye_, the **Glowstone Wrench** can be used on collections of blank **Neon Signs** to create a custom sign! Draw any shapes in any colors you want. The **Glowstone Wrench** can also be used on signs with a symbol to change its color.
